reviews.text: I have been using Pool Master over Texas for weekly service for several years.  The technicians are prompt, very courteous and have consistently kept my pool in excellent condition.   Zane and his staff are very responsive, and I have used them for minor repairs as well as replacing the mastic around my pool.  They do an excellent job at a fair and reasonable price.  Before using Pool Master, I serviced my pool myself, but struggled to properly balance the chemicals.  Since I began using them, I don’t have to worry about having a crystal clear pool to enjoy.   I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Denny Havener

reviews.text: We have been using Zane and his company for a few years now and couldn’t be happier. They come the same day every week and are very professional and are sweet to my dogs when they’re out in the back and I’ve never had any concerns with my pool because they keep on top of it. It’s so nice to enjoy my pool without Having to worry about doing the chemicals and balancing everything myself.
reviews.author: Shayla Nichols

reviews.text: The guys at UP Pools are not only knowledgeable but also very caring.  They take the time to explain everything and don't beat up your wallet when something needs to be repaired or replaced.  Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Tim Schwab

reviews.text: I had a weekly maintenance package. I had several conversations about the service I received and the lack of emptying the baskets, algae growing under their regular maintenance, and other work that was not completed. They even sent out a specialist to confirm that we had algae problem and had to re-train.  I  gave them several opportunities to fix the work with a promise that the technician will be changed and a new supervisor was to be more vigilant. Did not happen. Same problems. I was promised a call by the owner. Also did not happen. Just too many problems and broken promises. Had to move on.
reviews.author: Ivonne Ruggles

reviews.text: We’ve been with Zane and Pool Masters for many years.  Great service, very comprehensive and professional.  Great group of service technicians!
reviews.author: Charles Jerasa

reviews.text: Always on time, great at repairing quickly needed adjustments and fair pricing. They do care from Zane (owner) to all the employees on down. Recommend them!
reviews.author: Michael Menegay

reviews.text: Going on my 13th year with Pool Master and couldn't be happier with their service. Easy going guys willing to work with you when major pool/filter reairs are needed and their weekly service keeps the water Crystal Clear. On the few occasions where the water got murky/cloudy, they're all over it till the problem is fixed. My HIGHEST recommendation!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.author: WilliamSLeibSr

reviews.text: Pool master goes above and beyond to take care of our needs. Shea is always friendly and courteous and always takes time to respond and answer all of our questions. We would highly recommend this cy.
reviews.author: Mary Reich

reviews.text: Jordan completed a check up on our pool equipment.  He went over everything with me.  Recommended replacing g a missing skimmer door.
reviews.author: charles Jerasa

reviews.text: Love my pool service guys!! They are amazing; super communicative and always on top of everything. So happy with the service they provide!!
reviews.author: Stay

reviews.text: We love being customers at Pool Master! Zane and the whole crew at Pool Master never disappoint. They are a true delight! We know Pool Master will always deliver excellent, quality, and timely service. We wouldn’t use anyone else! Zane and his team are always responsive, personable, and they genuinely care about their customers. Our pool always looks great! Any time we have any questions about pool maintenance/care or the equipment (especially during the winter season), we know we can count on Pool Master. We’re also looking forward to doing much more remodeling work with them. Look no further for ALL of your pool needs! Oh and they install Christmas Lights too! Pool Master is the way to go!
reviews.author: Mary M

reviews.text: Zane and his crew were out working in rain to get my pool equipment fixed, which shows their work ethic. They are such a nice group of people, great experience.  We're looking forward to our first summer of monthly service with them.
reviews.author: JA Woo

reviews.text:
WOW!!
WE HAVE BEEN POOL MASTER’s 3rd CUSTOMER SINCE ZANE STARTED HIS COMPANY!
We were looking for pool service with consistent  service @ a great value.  I have never needed to price check over the years.
We use the service year round including Christmas lights.  Pool Master Over Texas has been very reputable and responsive, whether temperatures plunge, leaves drop or the hot days of summer.
Never a need to micromanage!  Service just happens and if you need special attention to equipment, Zane will make it happen,,,,,,
Thank you,
Jim in Saddlebrook
reviews.author: James Unrau

reviews.text: Pool Masters is a professional and very reasonably priced pool service company. I used them for several years when I had a pool and was very pleased. Zane and his team are very knowledgeable and their service is always complete and well-done. He can do repairs and clean filters too.
reviews.author: Jamie Wilder

reviews.text: Great company to work with!!!  I am a general contractor and have utilized Zane and his crew on multiple projects that have turned out spectacularly.
reviews.author: Jason Winkle

reviews.text: Pool master over Texas provided Professional service and fast response, I had a leak that they were able to fix and get my pool up and running in 24 hours. Recommend 110% great reliable pool service!
reviews.author: Darrell Nahoolewa

reviews.text: Randy is extremely helpful and knowledgeable. He will work with you and he brings far more options to the table than other pool repair companies.
reviews.author: Robert Lore

reviews.text: Not only are they professional and consistent, but any other pool issues I’ve had, they have referred me to people who have fixed issues out of their scope in a timely manner and with straight forward pricing. I call Pool Master Over Texas first now for any pool related matter because I know the job will get done right. I have more pressing matters at times and it’s nice to know when the family wants to use the pool, it will look and be maintained without further effort on my part. Zane and is team do it the right way, in a straight forward manner.
reviews.author: Aaron Elmer

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic. The positive reviews are detailed, mention specific staff and long-term relationships, and show varied writing styles. The single negative review is highly specific and credible, detailing a failure to correct service issues despite promises. The clustering of several 5-star reviews in March is a minor anomaly but not definitive proof of manipulation. The company seems to have many satisfied long-term customers but may have consistency issues with some service technicians.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted in the same month (March)
Some reviews are very brief and generic (e.g., 'Love my pool service guys!!')

negative_evidence: Failed to correct algae issue despite promises and re-training
positive_evidence: Mentions of returning to fix murky water problems

authentic_signals: Specific details: technician names (Zane, Shea, Jordan), service types (weekly maintenance, mastic replacement, equipment check-up)
Long-term customer relationships mentioned (13 years, many years)
One detailed negative review with specific, credible issues and timeline
complaint_patterns: Service quality issues (algae, not emptying baskets)
Failure to follow through on corrective promises
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one primary review platform (Google) has data. No other platforms have ratings to compare, so no discrepancy can be assessed.
